title: Subscription payment failed
description: A period of a subscription could not be paid from the customer's wallet (for example for lack of funds). The subscription is now past due. Billing retries on a bounded schedule and reports every failed attempt; it never provisions or stops anything for the Tenant System, which decides what past due means for it. When `willRetry` is false the attempts have run out and Billing stops trying on its own. This schema describes the `data` member of the delivered document; the envelope (id, type, tenantId, occurredAt, data) is described in README.md.

amount.description: The amount the period costs. Absent when the price could not be determined.

reason.description: A short code such as `insufficient_funds`, `price_unavailable` or `renewal_error`.

attempt.description: Which try at paying this period failed, starting at 1.

nextAttemptAt.description: When Billing tries again. Absent when `willRetry` is false.

money.description: An amount in minor units (cents, dong) of one ISO 4217 currency.
